objective: Extend target-independent divisor-kernel discovery beyond degree 15 before deciding whether an unknown-scalar run is feasible.

public_discovery.sizing_reason: dimension 11 is the smallest expected divisor dimension with two times dimension at least 21
public_discovery.candidate_source: all degree-11 divisors of T^21-1 over F2
public_discovery.admission: the factor-base cofactor classes can sum to zero with exactly two summands
public_discovery.selection_rule: among admitted candidates, maximize rational factor-base points; then minimize projected signed-Frobenius columns; then choose lexicographically lower divisor indices

decision_gate: Freeze a separate unknown-scalar protocol only if discovery terminates, at least one candidate is admitted, and the selected base is within the current materialisation guard.
claim_boundary: A public degree-21 census or later toy solve is not a scaling law, crossover, novelty or SOTA result.
